about_the_game:
Monster experimentation meets facility management. SCP New Management is a strategic simulation game where the player oversees an organization dedicated to containing and experimenting on supernatural phenomena.

"You play your little games. You finally get all of us. But then what happens?"

Not all threats can be explained by science. These anomalies, otherwise known as SCPs are sent to your facility. They are unpredictable, often dangerous, and need to be shielded from humanity.

The anomalies inhabiting this universe include:

  • SCP-049 // Plague Doctor

  • SCP-079 // Old AI

  • SCP-096 // The Shy Guy

  • SCP-106 // The Old Man

  • SCP-173 // The Sculpture

  • SCP-500 // Panacea

  • SCP-682 // The Indestructible Lizard

  • SCP-939 // With Many Voices

  • SCP-999 // The Tickle Monster

  • And more- yet to be announced!

A new site is nothing without rooms! Expand and customize your facility to meet the growing demands of containment, research, and security. Begin construction above the surface, and when space runs out you must head deeper below ground- with up to four subterranean levels available.

Design your layout carefully for efficiency and safety. Create kitchens to feed personnel, medical bays to heal the injured, observatories for monitoring, and lots more!

Each time you level up, a new anomaly awaits. You will need to tailor a new containment cell based on its classification, size, and behavior. No two anomalies are alike, and once they are in your facility, you must keep them there.

Assign a researcher, perform experiments, push the limits of science, and uncover what makes these anomalies tick. To counteract their abilities, you'll need to assign the correct containment procedures. But keep in mind: knowledge comes at a cost, and every test risks triggering something you cannot control.

SCPs are not the only danger. Rival organizations, insurgent cells, and hostile groups will also attempt to breach your site. These assaults threaten not only containment but the secrecy of the entire foundation.

Running a site isn’t just bricks, tears, and concrete! A huge part is the people and the logistics. Hire and station workers with different skills: researchers, facility guards, engineers, medics, and more. Keep them equipped with the right tools and weapons for the job, or leave them unprepared if you're feeling frisky.

Balancing the economy is crucial! Every anomaly means more risk and more income, but the cost of running the site will weigh down your wallet.

As the operation grows, you will unlock powerful upgrades in the skill tree. Each time you take on a new SCP, you get more points. So invest wisely.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features characteristics and scenes of blood, gore, and graphic dismemberment. This includes audio such as screams, gunfire, and other sounds that some may find unpleasant. It also explores mature story themes, including terrorism, experiments and various lethal situations which are intended for mature audiences. We advise individuals who have experienced traumatic events, sensitive to load noises or flashing lights/images to refrain from playing SCP: Foundation Simulator.
